第一百三十四章 正与邪（第1页）
正与邪（正与邪（第22页）洛行舟双手结印，无数道乌光汇聚，仿佛整个顺天城，一下子迎来了黑夜。萧凉神色微微一凝，“荒神的力量。”苏清绾点头，她与萧凉一起在人皇宝库中见识过荒神的力量。这种力量极为诡异，拥有极为恐怖的侵蚀性。在这时候，程观策的儒家文字接触到那乌光，嗤嗤响声不住传出，肉眼可见的腾腾黑烟不住冒出。儒家的力量代表的是正，是浩然正气，是生机，而荒神的力量是谢，是毁灭。这两股一亮，从天地开辟之初便是对立的。此时此刻，不论是程观策还是洛行舟，他们各自额头上都有汗珠子在滚落。显然两种截然不同的道则冲击之下，他们都不好受。僵持中，在他们的身后，各种景象在不住显化。程观策的身后，是一幅幅儒家教学的画面，是众生通过读书考取功名，以及摸爬滚打等各种众生之相。而在洛行舟的身后，则是毁灭交替，天地崩溃。生与灭的力量，在这时候得到了极大的体现。在他们大战之时，大熙边关之处，荒国的大军以及诸多荒神教的教徒分成两个队伍。荒神教的队伍，全是暗红色的袍子，而军队则是穿着黑色的盔甲。军队最厉害的，不是单个人的力量，而是阵法。而秦聪，则是这两支队伍真正的掌控者。他立在虚空中，双目泛着暗红色的光芒，印诀结出，虚空中顿然出现诸多肉眼可见的诡异生灵。它们或是植物，或是一些变异了的动物，彼此之间相融，不断使道则发生变化，汇聚在秦聪这里之后，则是化作了一条条黑色交织的丝线，而且还在不住压缩。“姬临风，当年一战之后，你我当时多年不曾见面了。”秦聪声音传出，透着复杂与沧桑。“当年我能打退你们，现在自然也可以。”姬临风双手背负在身后，立在阵法之上。当年的流川一战，荒国大军的领兵人物，也是荒神教教主秦聪。不论是从修为上的交锋，还是用兵以及其他各个方面，他们都是旗鼓相当的，都是彼此最好的对手。“既然如此，多说无益，那便战吧。”秦聪声音落下，手朝着虚空中轻轻一按，恐怖的乌光顿然如潮水一般呼啸而出。霎时间，虚空中顿然出现无数道则显化的生灵，它们蕴含极为恐怖的力量，密密麻麻地朝着姬临风卷来。姬临风身子微微一顿，一杆长枪顿然出现在手上，汇聚的阵法力量灌注长枪之中，迎击出去。轰隆巨响之声传来，虚空中顿然出现好几道长几百丈的口子。乱流呼啸涌动，宛若天河，毁灭之力漫卷，遮云蔽日。姬临风神色甚是凝重，从这一次交锋，他感知到秦聪等人的力量更为恐怖，其间夹杂着一股不明的力量。如果不出意外的话，那就是传说中的荒神之力。以此来看，恐怕荒神教已经与荒神之间有一定的联系，这对于整个天下来说，可都不是什么好事啊。

Chapter 134 Good and Evil (Page 1)
Goodness and Evil (Goodness and Evil (Page 22)) Luo Xingzhou formed a seal with his hands, and countless black lights gathered, as if the entire Shuntian City suddenly ushered in the dark night. Xiao Liang's expression condensed slightly, "The power of the Desolate God." Su Qingwan nodded. She and Xiao Liang had seen the power of the Desolate God in the Human Emperor's Treasure House. This power is extremely weird and has extremely terrifying corrosiveness. At this time, Cheng Guance's Confucian writing came into contact with the black light. , The sound of chissing kept coming, and the visible black smoke kept rising. The power of Confucianism represents righteousness, and the power of Huangshen is destruction. These two forces have been in opposition since the beginning of the world. At this moment, both Cheng Guance and Luo Xingzhou had beads of sweat rolling down their foreheads. It was obvious that they were not affected by the impact of two completely different principles. It feels good. Behind them, various scenes are constantly unfolding. Behind Cheng Guance, there are scenes of Confucian teachings, and behind Luo Xingzhou, there is an alternation of destruction, and the collapse of the world. At this time, the power of life and destruction was greatly reflected. At the border of Daxi, the vastness of the country was revealed. The army and many members of the Huangshen Sect were all in dark red robes, while the army was wearing black armor. The most powerful thing about the army was not the strength of a single person, but the formation. Qin Cong was the real master of the two teams. He stood in the void, his eyes glowing with dark red, and many strange creatures visible to the naked eye suddenly appeared in the void. Or plants, or some mutated animals, blending with each other, constantly changing the Tao, and after gathering here, they turned into black intertwined threads, and they couldn't help but compress. "Ji Linfeng, after the first battle, you and I have not seen each other for many years." Qin Cong's voice came out, revealing the complexity and vicissitudes of life. "I could fight you off back then, and I can do it now." Ji Linfeng. Feng put his hands behind his back and stood on the formation. In the battle of Liuchuan, the leader of the Huangguo army was also Qin Cong, the leader of the Huangshen sect. Whether it was in terms of cultivation, military use or other aspects, they were equally matched, and they were each other's best opponents. "In this case, there is no point in talking, so let's fight." Qin Cong lowered his voice and pressed his hand lightly into the air, and a terrifying black light suddenly appeared. Like a tidal wave, countless creatures suddenly appeared in the void, and they were densely packed towards Ji Linfeng. A spear suddenly appeared in his hand, and the concentrated power of the formation poured into the spear, and he rushed out. There was a loud bang, and several turbulent holes suddenly appeared in the void. It moved like a river of destruction, covering up the clouds and the sun. Ji Linfeng's expression was very solemn. From this confrontation, he sensed that the power of Qin Cong and others was even more terrifying, mixed with an unknown force. If nothing unexpected happened, it was the power of the Huangshen. From this point of view, I am afraid that the Huangshen Sect has a certain connection with the Huangshen, which is not a good thing for the whole world.
